guardrails: No outcome or clinical variable is generated.
All seeds are deterministic and registry-derived.
True shared and private scores are retained for simulation-only evaluation.
Null-shared scenarios contain zero true shared factors.
Patient-pair corruption is explicitly recorded by row-source maps.
TARGET-OS outcomes and biological annotations are never accessed.

latent_model.matrix_equation: block_scale * (shared_strength * f_view(Z_shared W_shared^T) + private_strength * Z_private W_private^T + feature_offset + noise)
latent_model.private_loadings: View-specific sparse loadings generated independently from shared loadings.
latent_model.private_scores: Independent standardized Gaussian score matrix per view.
latent_model.shared_loadings: View-specific sparse loadings with 10% support per factor and unit root-mean-square loading on the support.
latent_model.shared_scores: Common standardized Gaussian Z_shared in canonical sample order.

missingness.mechanism: entry-level MCAR with an exact prespecified count

nonlinear_modes.methylation_tanh: Tanh shared mapping in methylation; identity in RNA and CNV.
nonlinear_modes.none: Identity shared mapping in every view.
nonlinear_modes.view_specific_monotonic: Standardized linear RNA, tanh methylation, signed-square-root CNV.

pair_corruption.mechanism: Independent deterministic derangement of the prespecified row fraction in each non-anchor view.
